notes:
Introducing Ascent Compliance OS 2.0 — a complete visual rebuild, top to bottom.

• New interface: redesigned from the ground up into a flatter, denser, enterprise-grade layout built for daily compliance work — clearer tables, sharper hierarchy, and far less visual noise.

• New brand identity: a new Ascent mark and a refined navy-and-gold visual language, carried consistently across every screen — from sign-in to reports.

• Persistent navigation: a compact sidebar now keeps every module — GST, Tally, Income Tax, Audit — one click away at all times, replacing the old home-only navigation.

• One unified design system: every table, dashboard, and status indicator now follows the same visual language, so screens read faster and feel like one coherent product.

• Adjustable text size: a new A−/A+ control lets you scale the entire interface to your comfort, available from the sign-in screen onward.

• Dozens of smaller fixes: contrast, spacing, and layout polish across GST, Reconciliation, Tally, and Admin screens.

Your data, workflows, and Tally connections are unchanged — this release is entirely about how the app looks and feels to use.
